reason: I read labels and compare forms and doses. One form of magnesium at 200 mg for $30 a month doesn't beat the blends I already look at, and I don't know this brand. The lab report is a good sign, but a new brand on TikTok Shop is still a risk for me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? I also have no reviews to read yet, and I can't tell if the named lab is one I'd trust.
would_change_my_mind: A number of verified reviews from real buyers, plus a clear reason why bisglycinate alone is enough, with the lab report showing the actual tested amount.
